column1: # Columns, tab-separated:  name  addr  size  mode  note
#   name  the field name; port/trace.c emits it under exactly this name
#         (`zeliard --trace-fields` lists them; tracediff refuses unknown ones)
#   addr  hex offset in BASE (the oracle's base.bin frame)
#   size  bytes.  1 and 2 decode as little-endian unsigned ints; longer fields
#         decode as a lowercase hex string in memory order
#   mode  fight = only at fight.bin 717F boundaries, town = only at town.bin 68ED,
#   note  free text (docs/STATE_PAGE.md / docs/FIGHT.md names and caveats)
# Record lists.  A header row, then member rows:
#   NAME[]        ADDR or [PTR]  STRIDE  mode  SPEC -- note
# ADDR is the first record; [PTR] is the address of a u16 pointer to it.
#   end=+O:SIZE:HEX  stop before a record whose field at +O equals HEX
#   dead=+O:SIZE:HEX a record whose field at +O equals HEX is dead: only
#                    NAME[i].live = 0 is decoded for it (live records get .live = 1)
# Decoded names: NAME.n (the record count), NAME[i].field, NAME[i].live (dead= lists).
# Fields the port does not model are simply absent from its trace; they can
# still be listed here so the oracle side can be read (tracediff --dump).
# ---- story flags BASE:0000-0048 (STATE_PAGE.md 'Story flags'); boss flags at 00 08 10 18 20 28 30 32 47, [03]|=0x20 cavern 1 cleared
